run_segment_th: run the segment_th.py module to tokenize Thai text from stdin into space-separated words
run_word_tokenize_th: run word_tokenize from pythainlp to segment Thai sentences into individual words
run_segment_stdin: run the script to read Thai text lines from stdin and output word-segmented tokens
run_thai_tokenizer: run the Thai word tokenizer that splits Thai text into space-delimited word tokens
run_line_processor: run the line-by-line Thai word segmentation pipeline reading from standard input
